title: fix(knowledge-turso): search exhausted by generation switches answers CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION 409
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DG44bgtJm8kWx4oK68re6GX)_
Fixes #37597

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:知识库用 turso 存储时,重建期间一次检索连续三次撞上索引切换,调用方收到的错误从"服务不可用 503"改为"并发修改 409",与 pgvector 存储一致。
- 为什么做:让两种知识库存储对同一情况给出同一种可重试的错误(知识检索后续收口专题)。
- 出错会怎样:只影响这一种罕见的检索失败的错误码,正常检索结果不变;可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/knowledge-turso/src/turso-adapter.ts`: the search-exhaustion branch of `searchAttempt` (the active generation switched on each of `SEARCH_ATTEMPTS` = 3 attempts) now throws `{ code: 'CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION', status: 409 }` through a module-private `switchedDuringSearch` helper, instead of `notReady(...)` (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` 503). This is the envelope pgvector answers for the same condition (`pgvector-adapter.ts`, the `SEARCH_ATTEMPTS` exhaustion in `search`): no `remedy`, no retryable flag, the code constant declared beside `SEARCH_ATTEMPTS` with pgvector's doc line. The message keeps the source name and the "retry it" instruction: `The knowledge search was not answered: its source's index was switched while it searched. The active generation of source 'X' changed 3 times during one search; retry it.`
- Retry count, the happy path and every other answer are unchanged. No new export, no adapter-contract member (epic #37000 ruling). `CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION` is already a standard code (`packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts`), so no new code.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/knowledge-turso` patch.

## Tests

- `acceptance.test.ts`: the existing case "a search whose generation keeps being switched under it stops after three attempts" now pins `{ code: 'CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION', status: 409 }` and still pins `n === 3` (the retry count). It runs under both the `:memory:` and the `file:` URL suites.
- Ablation: with the origin/main adapter restored on disk, the case is red in both suites (`- "code": "CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION"` / `+ "code": "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE"`); restored from HEAD afterwards, tree clean.

## Acceptance notes

- The two message lines of the exhaustion branch are left byte-identical on purpose: open PR #37676 rewrites the next line (`opts.source.id` to `opts.source.name`), and touching only the `throw` line keeps the two branches textually mergeable (`overlap-check` exit 0 against #37676).
- turso's `upsert` exhaustion (`UPSERT_ATTEMPTS`) does not share this helper: it throws a bare `Error` with no `code`/`status`, exactly as pgvector's `upsert` exhaustion does. The two stores agree there, so there is no mismatch to note; left unchanged (out of the card).

## Verification

- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/knowledge-turso exec vitest run src/__tests__/acceptance.test.ts -t 'keeps being switched'` shows 2 passed (both suites).
- Read first: the `searchAttempt` exhaustion branch and `switchedDuringSearch` in `turso-adapter.ts`.

- Package: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/knowledge-turso test` (Test Files 3 passed, Tests 156 passed) and `typecheck` (tsc + check:test-typecheck OK), under the verify lock, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Derived families (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 66): 65 exit 0, including `check:error-status-conformance` ("every derivable runtime status is documented, and every documented status is reachable", no baseline rows needed). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (needs a full build): NOT MEASURED locally, CI runs it. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 accounted, 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED.
